title: Consolidation: The National Stage: Theatre, Censorship & Politics

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can retell the history of Hungarian theatre from 1837 to the 1980s in a few sentences.
I can use hogy + subjunctive for purpose and wishes and nehogy + subjunctive for precautions.
I can use the 3rd-person subjunctive for a demand and warn with figyelmeztet, nehogy ...
I can use the main theatre words of this unit in context.
